project.name: Gimle Example: hello-module
project.description: A minimal, real, deployable Gimle module artifact -- a genuine JPMS module (module-info.class, not an automatic module) plus META-INF/gimle/gimle-module.yaml -- built to give the local-dev runbook (gimle-console/LOCAL_DEV.md) something real to point a deployment's artifactPath at, since gimle-module's own TestModuleBuilder compiles fixtures in-memory for tests and was never meant to produce a checked-in, shippable artifact. No health probes or lifecycle hooks: both are optional per gimle-module.yaml's schema (ModuleDescriptorParser defaults to HealthProbes.NONE / no hooks when absent), matching the minimal shape TestModuleBuilder.minimalDescriptor() already uses for the same reason -- kept minimal on purpose, not because a real module can't have them.
